# RenderSettings

Scene-wide ambient light and distance fog (Unity: RenderSettings).

Availability: **PSX** yes | **PSP** yes | **PS2** yes

The component or type needs the `lighting` feature (run-time lights on meshes with a material). If it is missing: bake light into vertex colors (DirectionalLight).

Put one `RenderSettings` on any object. The first active one is used. Without one, ambient is black and fog is off.

## Members

| Member | PSX | PSP | PS2 | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Color32 ambient` | yes | yes | yes | Light added to every lit surface. |
| `bool fogEnabled` | yes | yes | yes | Turns distance fog on. |
| `Color32 fogColor` | yes | yes | yes | Color the scene fades to. |
| `Scalar fogStart` | yes | yes | yes | Distance where fog begins. |
| `Scalar fogEnd` | yes | yes | yes | Distance where fog is complete. Keep it above `fogStart` and inside the camera far plane. |

## Notes

- Set the camera clear color to `fogColor` so the horizon matches the fog.

## Example

```cpp
RenderSettings* r = GameObject::Find("RenderSettings")->GetComponent<RenderSettings>();
r->fogEnabled = true;
r->fogStart = 8; r->fogEnd = 24;
```
